register.labelZh: MEET 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: meet up 可以讓你自然地談論與朋友、同學或同事見面。；meet something with something 可以表示人們以憤怒、沉默、支持、笑聲或其他方式回應某事。；meet with something 可以描述意外、困難、延誤和成功。；這些表達能幫助你分辨與人見面、回應某事和經歷某件事情等不同意思。
register.summaryEn: Meet up lets you talk naturally about seeing friends, classmates or colleagues. Meet something with something can show whether people respond with anger, silence, support, laughter or another reaction. Meet with something can describe accidents, difficulties, delays and success. These expressions help you distinguish meeting a person from reacting to something or experiencing an event.
